_note: Hand-written queries for the 8 MIMIC-IV-ECG report-derived concepts, written 2026-10-23 before any MIMIC model existed and frozen with the label mapping. Same template policy as PTB-XL (class names, short clinical descriptions, report-style statements), English only (MIMIC machine reports are English). PRIMARY readout: the 'clinical' family ensemble. Caveat: the report-style family was written after viewing the MIMIC statement vocabulary (needed to build the label mapping), so it may resemble real machine statements; it is reported as secondary. Infarct prompts avoid acute-MI wording (the concept is a reported infarct pattern, mostly old / age undetermined). Never edited using results.

normal_ecg: normal sinus rhythm with normal intervals and morphology
atrial_fibrillation: irregularly irregular rhythm without p waves
atrial fibrillation with variable ventricular rate
chaotic atrial activity, irregular rr intervals
reported_infarct_pattern: pathological q waves from a prior infarct
intraventricular_conduction_abnormality: wide qrs due to intraventricular conduction delay
right or left bundle branch block
fascicular block or intraventricular conduction defect
left_ventricular_hypertrophy: increased qrs voltage consistent with ventricular hypertrophy
left ventricular hypertrophy with strain pattern
st_t_changes: nonspecific st and t wave changes
t wave inversion and st depression
sinus_bradycardia: slow sinus rhythm below 60 beats per minute
low heart rate with normal p waves
sinus_tachycardia: fast sinus rhythm above 100 beats per minute
high heart rate with normal p waves

normal_ecg: sinus rhythm with normal axis and intervals
atrial_fibrillation: atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response
left_ventricular_hypertrophy: left ventricular hypertrophy with secondary st-t changes
